interaction: Drag the tonearm onto a band of the record (or press Play, pick one of six tracks, or press Enter on the focused tonearm): the platter spins up and an original lo-fi loop is synthesised live with chord pads, bass, noise-burst drums, bell keys and vinyl crackle, driving a spectrum visualiser; each track changes tempo, key, progression and accent colour, with volume and stop controls; the merch table adds a tee, LP or tote to a demo crate.
notes: Each track plays a short generated loop, not a full song; music pauses when the tab is hidden. Checkout, ticket links and the mailing list end in demo toasts.
